extracted.name: Hawaiian Pineapple Sweet & Sour Smoked Sausage
extracted.description: This easy Hawaiian dish features sautéed smoked sausage, red bell pepper, and fresh pineapple with sweet chili garlic sauce served over steaming rice.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) package Hillshire Farm® Smoked Sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices
1 cup fresh pineapple, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instruction_lines: Cook and stir sausage and bell pepper in a large saucepan over medium-high heat until sausage is lightly browned and peppers are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add chili garlic sauce and pineapple; cook and stir for 5 minutes.
